title: New NLEX segment from Valenzuela to Quezon City toll-free until end of 2026 — Marcos
summary: The new North Luzon Expressway (NLEX) Northlink Segment that stretches from Valenzuela to Quezon City will be toll-free until the end of the year, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said on Thursday…

blocks.text: The new North Luzon Expressway (NLEX) Northlink Segment that stretches from Valenzuela to Quezon City will be toll-free until the end of the year, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said on Thursday after he attended the opening of the road network in the capital city.
